description: RFC 0016 K1 'Feature support recorded' (render.device.vulkan-features): support for the three features the Vulkan adapter (render/device/vulkan/) requires, timeline semaphores, synchronization2 and dynamic rendering, per declared profile. Each measured entry is the device render/device/vulkan/instance.cpp's SelectAdapter would choose, probed by tools/render/vulkan_features_probe.c (probe --platform linux|android --entry). 'core' means the device's API version includes the feature (1.2 for timeline semaphores, 1.3 for the others); 'extension' means the device lists the KHR extension; 'supported' is the feature bit from vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2. Required profile: linux-desktop; android-fold7 (user decision 2026-10-08) and Apple rows are optional (AGENTS.md) and are unavailable until an Apple runner exists. Checked by 'python3 tools/render/vulkan_features.py check'.

android-tab-s8-ultra.note: Samsung's Adreno 730 driver is Vulkan 1.1 without VK_KHR_dynamic_rendering. Host mode serves it (user decision 2026-09-29): the legacy backend draws in its own render passes; the port refuses rendering passes and graphics pipelines. Serving it on the core is a cutover requirement (RFC 0016 K9 'Devices without dynamic rendering').
